searchText: <@!498009160982724610> Confirmed that the second bootnode is online but the ENR in that repo had the wrong node ID. https://github.com/eth2-clients/eth2-mainnet/pull/5 updates it to the correct one which I'm getting responses from. And I can confirm I'm getting far fewer responses from our bootnode than I would have expected or that we get from other nodes. Something is definitely not right. I have some wild theories but will need a bit more time to dig into it (I got bogged down a bit today with other stuff unfortunately). Let me know if this is causing you particular issues and needs to be handled urgently. Nah not urgent. Just pointing out strange behaviour which may effect tekus discovery. <@!498009160982724610> The LH bootnodes at https://github.com/eth2-clients/eth2-mainnet/blob/master/bootnodes.txt also didn't get updated (when I compare them with the ones on https://github.com/eth2-clients/eth2-testnets/tree/master/shared/mainnet). There are two PRs lingering now in that repo for bootnode updates :). Is any client actually using that repository? we could simply migrate the testnet repo to `eth2-networks` and get rid of the other one - github rename puts http forwards in place

excerpts.author: ajsutton
excerpts.content:
<@!498009160982724610> Confirmed that the second bootnode is online but the ENR in that repo had the wrong node ID.  https://github.com/eth2-clients/eth2-mainnet/pull/5 updates it to the correct one which I'm getting responses from.

And I can confirm I'm getting far fewer responses from our bootnode than I would have expected or that we get from other nodes.  Something is definitely not right.  I have some wild theories but will need a bit more time to dig into it (I got bogged down a bit today with other stuff unfortunately).

Let me know if this is causing you particular issues and needs to be handled urgently.

excerpts.content: Nah not urgent. Just pointing out strange behaviour which may effect tekus discovery.
